title: Explicit submersive presentation for Popescu Jacobian localization
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-popescu-delocalize-jacobian-localization, the displayed localization admits a SubmersivePresentation over R with variable type Fin (N+3) and relation type Fin (c+1).

source.place: Proof of Tag 07F9, final displayed localization and Jacobian criterion

proof.text: Let e insert the original N variables into positions 1 through N of Fin (N+2). Use Mathlib Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation.naive for the quotient by the renamed f_j, selecting e composed with Fin.castLE hc. Compose it with Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation.localizationAway at a = x_0 w product_j s_j. These are genuine presentations without any Jacobian-unit assumption.

Map the original polynomial ring to the localized quotient by phi. Each f_j maps to zero, so Ideal.span_le shows the ideal generated by them is contained in ker(phi). Apply this to hs to get phi(C(s_0)) = phi(h) phi(Delta). The localization makes a a unit; IsUnit.mul_iff and IsUnit.prod_univ_iff then make every s_j, in particular s_0, a unit. Another application of IsUnit.mul_iff makes phi(Delta) a unit. This works also for c = 0 and for the zero localization.

Compute the quotient presentation Jacobian using PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobiMatrix_apply and MvPolynomial.pderiv_rename for the injective e. Its matrix is the rename of the original selected partial-derivative matrix. AlgHom.map_det identifies its Jacobian image with phi(Delta). Mathlib PreSubmersivePresentation.comp_jacobian_eq_jacobian_smul_jacobian identifies the composed Jacobian with phi(Delta) times the image of a; both factors are units, yielding a SubmersivePresentation.

Reindex the variable and relation types Unit + Fin (N+2) and Unit + Fin c using finSumFinEquiv, Equiv.sumComm and the unique equivalence Fin 1 = Unit. SubmersivePresentation.reindex gives exactly Fin (N+3) and Fin (c+1).

proof_origin.note: Mathlib presentation composition and Jacobian formula implement the existing Stacks Tag 07F9 inverse-relation argument; the unit and renaming calculations are proved directly in Lean.

mathlib_searches.results: Found Mathlib theorem used after intermediate statement

lean.statement:
theorem popescu_auxiliary_submersivePresentation
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (N c t : ℕ) (hc : c ≤ N)
    (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin N) R)
    (s : Fin (t + 1) → R) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin N) R)
    (hs : C (s 0) - h * Matrix.det
      (fun i j : Fin c => pderiv (Fin.castLE hc i) (f j)) ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range f)) :
    Nonempty (SubmersivePresentation R (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span (Set.range (fun j : Fin c =>
        rename (fun i : Fin N => i.castSucc.succ) (f j))))
      (X (0 : Fin (N + 2)) * X (Fin.last (N + 1)) * C (∏ j : Fin (t + 1), s j))))
      (Fin (N + 3)) (Fin (c + 1)))
